subject: Next steps: WellCore discovery & procurement path
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@medtech.ai>, Lina Gomez <lina@wellcore.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: WellCore discovery & procurement path

Hi Samir / Lina —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap of what we heard and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned. I tried to keep this short and actionable.

Pain points discussed
- Latency spikes on patient-facing prompts during peak hours (current 95th perc ~1.2s for short prompts).
- Rising token costs as clinical note generation scales (~3x YoY).
- Tight compliance constraints: PHI handling, audit logs, and regionally restricted storage.

Current stack
- In-house horsetail LLM proxy + GPU pool for batch jobs (no production inference SLA).
- Primary data in GCP us-east1; some PHI workflows routed through a partner vault.

Success criteria for a first phase (what you told us)
1) 95th percentile latency <= 400ms for short prompts in production.
2) End-to-end per-note inference cost reduction of 30% (token + infra).
3) Full audit logging + KMS-based key control for PHI.

Decision process & stakeholders (from today)
- Technical PO: Samir Patel — leads evaluation and SRE validation.
- Procurement: Lina Gomez — will own contract and vendor questions.
- Legal/compliance: procurement@wellcore.com and external counsel (TBD).
- Executive approver: Head of Product (timeline depends on cost/SLAs).

Initial commercial guardrails we discussed
- Looking for 6–12 month pilot with measurable KPIs before committing to reserved capacity.
- Ballpark signing target: Aug–Sep if pilot metrics look good.

Proposed next steps (please confirm)
1) I will share a 1-page pilot proposal + indicative pricing for a 3-month pilot (attached).
2) You (Samir) to share any compliance questionnaire and a list of tech validation tests you want us to run.
3) Lina to share procurement timeline and PO routing details (who gets the quote, legal contacts).
4) Follow-up 30–45 minute call next week to review pilot scope and test plan.

Attachments: redwood-initial-pricing.pdf (initial pilot sketch / price bands)

If any of the bullets above are missing or inaccurate, flag them and I’ll update. Happy to tailor the pilot toward a shorter ramp if you prefer (start with a limited workload).

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

---
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform for production LLMs

From: Samir Patel <samir@medtech.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina@wellcore.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: WellCore discovery & procurement path

Thanks Neha — this is great and accurate. A couple quick clarifications from our side: we do want the pilot to cover both synchronous patient prompts and background batch summarization (so both latency and throughput). On compliance, I can share our vendor security questionnaire by EOD tomorrow — it includes SOC2 + encryption details we need verified.

Procurement timeline: Lina, we are aiming to have procurement sign-off by mid-September; happy to accelerate if legal can review an initial SOW sooner. Procurement contact is procurement@wellcore.com (copied).

One more note: our Head of Product (Diane Kim) will want a short note on fallback behavior and what happens if latency targets are missed during the pilot (can you include that in the pilot doc?).

Best,
Samir
Director of Platform Engineering, MedTech AI
samir@medtech.ai

Sergio / Vivek — forwarding the thread with WellCore. Samir confirmed pilot scope includes both sync patient prompts and batch summarization. Procurement timeline mid-Sep. They specifically asked for: fallback behavior language for Diane, compliance questionnaire (SOC2 details), and an SOW + pricing for a 3-month pilot.

Ask: can you please prepare the following by EOD Friday?
- A 1-page pilot SOW that includes acceptance criteria (latency 95th <=400ms; per-note cost target), fallback policy, and logs/KMS notes.
- Draft pricing in pricing-draft.xlsx (3 variants: trial-conservative, trial-optimized, reserved-option with a baseline monthly commit).
- A one-paragraph summary we can send to procurement@wellcore.com that lists billing contact, PO requirements, and expected payment terms.

Notes for pricing guardrails (my read):
- Pilot expected to start with 50–100 daily active clinical users and scale to ~1k/day if successful.
- Key compliance asks: KMS key control, audit logs retained 7 years, regional storage in us-east1.

I’ll attach the initial pricing doc I sent them (redwood-initial-pricing.pdf) and open a HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890.

Thanks — let me know if any of this is unclear. I can join a quick call with legal if we need to fast-track the SOW.

Neha

Attachments forwarded: redwood-initial-pricing.pdf

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Next steps: WellCore discovery & procurement path (prepare pilot pricing)

Thanks — I’ll take lead on pricing and pilot SOW. Quick internal plan:

1) Pricing bands (ballpark)
- Trial-conservative: $0.06 / 1k tokens + $450/day baseline for reserved warm workers (good for small pilot).
- Trial-optimized: $0.045 / 1k tokens + $650/day with prefix caching and agressive batching assumed (expected 25–35% lower unit cost).
- Reserved-option (if they commit 3 months): flat monthly commit $60k + overage at $0.035 / 1k tokens.

2) Pilot SOW highlights to include
- Acceptance criteria: 95th <=400ms for short prompts (measured across 7 days), throughput test to sustain 50 rps for 1 hour, audit logs sent to their logging endpoint.
- Fallback behavior: automatic regional fallback to a compatible model with metric-based rollback; provider credits if SLA misses >2 consecutive days.
- Compliance: KMS integration required; we will provide SOC2 report and relevant encryption specs.

3) Next internal steps
- I will prepare pricing-draft.xlsx and the 1-page SOW by EOD Friday. Vivek — please prepare a short note on operational dependencies (how long for a private VPC setup if they need it).
- After internal review, Neha will send to procurement@wellcore.com and ccs.

Draft commercial guardrails look conservative but leave room to tighten after the pilot metrics. Will include a short fallback paragraph for Diane.

Sergio Alvarez
Senior Commercial Manager, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
